name: Synlig AEO Service
description: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) measurement for Norwegian brands. Our main product is a citation measurement (sitert-måling, 9 900 NOK ex. VAT): five buying-intent questions from your market, at least nine runs over several days with byte-identical prompts, and the names of whoever gets cited when you are not. Written report with raw data by email, invoiced with 14-day terms, no meetings. Implementation is sold separately and small: Synlig Lite (990 NOK) adds FAQPage JSON-LD to one page.

skills.name: Free AEO Audit
skills.description: Instant AI-visibility audit for any business website. Returns score (0-100), grade (A-F), and prioritized recommendations. Free, no signup required. Works for any URL but tuned for Norwegian B2B SaaS.
examples: Audit the AEO score for https://example.no
How visible is this SaaS in ChatGPT and Perplexity?

endpointParams.url: required — the website URL to audit

skills.name: AI Citation Measurement (Sitert-måling)
skills.description: Measures whether AI assistants cite a Norwegian brand in its own market, and names who gets cited instead. Method: five buying-intent questions, at least nine runs over several days, byte-identical prompts, written report with raw data by email. Pricing (two packages, ex. VAT): Sitert-måling 9 900 NOK one-time (invoice, 14-day terms, no meetings) and Synlig Lite 990 NOK one-time (FAQPage JSON-LD for one page, 1 business day). A measurement is a measurement — we do not promise a ranking improvement. Method and its limits: https://synligdigital.no/metode. Order a measurement by email to hei@synligdigital.no with subject 'Sitert-måling', stating company, market/category and competitors.
